tooltip: "Teaches you how to cook Skywall Souffle."

guaranteedRewards.name: Skywall Souffle
tooltip: Use: Restores 17 health over 18 sec. Must remain seated while eating. If you spend at least 10 sec eating, you will become well fed and gain 1 Stamina for 15 min. Additionally, experience gained from kills is increased by 5%.

narrative.details:
Up for a bit of work? I could use a bit of muscle from a strong adventuring-type such as yourself. With how dangerous things are getting around here, no one's had much time to hunt or forage of late, and I need someone to get out there and source me fresh eggs and strider meat to keep this village fed.

I'd be happy to teach you one of my famous recipes if you can bring me what I need. What do you say?
narrative.objectives: Collect 3 Small Eggs and 8 Strider Meat from creatures found throughout the Shen'dar Highlands.
narrative.offerRewardText: These eggs aren't easy to get but wind save me, they are DELICIOUS fried up in a bit of ursera tallow.If you've got a bit of time to spare and you enjoy cooking, I can teach you a few tips and tricks I've picked up. Say the word and I'd be happy to train you.
narrative.requestItemsText: No matter how much things change here on Zephras and how uncertain things get, I always say that a pipe full of dried peacebloom and nice full belly is a comfort that can't be beat!
